decision.reasoning: The user is asking an analysis question about their sequenced samples, specifically asking where chromatin is open. According to the routing instructions, analyses of the user's own sequencing data (such as finding open chromatin, mutations, or peaks) are routed to nextseek_query. The pipeline agent will handle this by offering the appropriate nf-core run to produce the requested data.

replies:
I've built an nf-core/atacseq run for these four paired-end ATAC-seq libraries. It isn't ready to launch yet because I need to know the species to set the reference genome.

**What the run gives you:** open-chromatin peaks for each sample and a combined set of peaks across all four, with read counts per peak for each sample. The pipeline also runs a basic DESeq2 comparison on those counts. That gives a first look at which regions open up with JQ1 treatment compared with the controls. With only two replicates per group, treat it as preliminary.

**Samplesheet** (one sheet, 4 samples):
| Sample | Name | Condition | Replicate |
|---|---|---|---|
| D.SEQ-261028BMC-7 | NTC-ATAC-ctrl-1 | CTRL | 1 |
| D.SEQ-261028BMC-8 | NTC-ATAC-ctrl-2 | CTRL | 2 |
| D.SEQ-261028BMC-9 | NTC-ATAC-jq1-1 | JQ1 | 1 |
| D.SEQ-261028BMC-10 | NTC-ATAC-jq1-2 | JQ1 | 2 |

**Settings:**
- **Aligner:** BWA
- **Peak calling:** MACS2 in broad mode, the default
- **Input controls:** none
- **Read length:** set to 50, the closest option the pipeline accepts for these 38 bp reads. It's only used to estimate genome size for peak calling.
- **Pipeline check:** the settings pass the pipeline's own validation.

**Reference genome: not set.** None of the sample records say which organism these cells come from, so I can't pick a genome. Which species are they? Human (GRCh38), mouse (GRCm39 or mm10), or something else? Also, references for ATAC-seq still need to be set up on Luria before this can launch.

**Run time:** there's no estimate for this pipeline yet.

When it finishes, just tell Nessie "my run is done" and Nessie will turn the outputs into NExtSEEK upload workbooks for you to review.

Tell me the species, or anything else you'd like changed, such as narrow peaks or the bowtie2 aligner.
